# UI testing inventory — `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell`

**Scope:** `src/renderer/src/components` (~120 files declare `data-testid`; ~500+ total attributes including dynamic IDs).  
**Default shell:** `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL` → `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` + `MultiWorkspace` (`App.jsx`). Legacy path still mounts `WorkspacePanel` when that flag is false.

---

## 2. LLM provider support

### `bridge.test` (IPC `llm:bridge:test`)

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Renderer API** | `window.api.bridge.test(profile)` |
| **IPC** | `llm:bridge:test` in `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\main.js` (~3214) |
| **Preload** | `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\src\preload.js` |
| **Probe logic** | `LLMService.getModelList()` + `getHealth()`; validates `http(s)://` baseUrl, API key if `requiresApiKey`, `allowRemoteBridge` / airgap for remote |
| **Returns** | `{ ok, baseUrl, provider, models[], modelCount, health }` |
| **Unit tests** | No dedicated `bridge.test` file; related: `tear/unit-tests.js` (profile model), `tear/provider-errors.test.js`, `tear/app-trust-polish.test.js` |
| **E2E** | `e2e/react-core.spec.js` — expects `settings-provider-select` = `ollama`, clicks `settings-test-connection-btn` |

### Catalog (all supported by `bridge.test` when configured)

| Provider ID | Protocol | Remote | API key | Default base URL | Source |
|-------------|----------|--------|---------|------------------|--------|
| `ollama` | ollama | no | no | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | `src/bridgeProviderCatalog.js` |
| `openai` | openai | yes | yes | `https://api.openai.com` | same |
| `openrouter` | openai | yes | yes | `https://openrouter.ai/api` | same |
| `groq` | openai | yes | yes | `https://api.groq.com/openai` | same |
| `together` | openai | yes | yes | `https://api.together.xyz` | same |
| `custom_openai` | openai | yes | yes | `https://api.example.com` | same |

**Runtime gates:** remote providers need `settings.allowRemoteBridge`; keys via profile/settings or env (`llmSweep.js` `ENV_BINDINGS`). Invalid provider IDs normalize to `ollama`.

### `connectionProfiles` (settings)

- **Shape:** `{ id, name, provider, baseUrl, timeoutMs, retryCount, defaultModel, apiKey, trustState, … }` — `src/bridgeProfileModel.js`
- **Active profile:** `settings.activeProfileId` or first profile — used in `SettingsDrawer.resolveActiveBridgeProfile`, `ActiveProfileBar`, `App.jsx` bridge flows
- **Seeded default:** `local-default` / Ollama when array empty

### SettingsDrawer provider UI

`PROVIDER_OPTIONS` in `SettingsDrawer.jsx` (lines 22–28) matches the catalog 1:1 (labels differ slightly, e.g. “Local Node (Ollama)”).

**Related (not `bridge.test`):** `ProviderSweep` → `runLlmSweep` (`llm:bridge:sweep` path in main); `settings-provider-sweep-btn` refreshes all catalog providers.

---

## 3. Theater / fake / unwired controls

| Surface | Control | Why theater | File |
|---------|---------|-------------|------|
| **Recovery shell** | `knowledge-base-panel` | Explicit: “not wired in the recovery shell yet” | `RecoveryWorkspacePanelsLayer.jsx` |
| **Recovery shell** | `multi-model-split-panel` | Placeholder copy only; no compare host | same |
| **Settings** | P2P Network Tunnel toggle | `opacity-60`, “Requires APEX”; `networkTunnel` only persisted in settings — **no main-process consumer** | `SettingsDrawer.jsx` |
| **Omega boot** | `omega-boot-overlay` / lines | Timed cosmetic sequence from `report.bootSequence`; skip just hides UI | `OmegaBootOverlay.jsx` |
| **Legacy renderer** | Various “UI only” badges | Old vanilla UI labels (`src/renderer.js` ~5640+) | Not in React components |
| **Demo ecosystem** | Ecosystem launcher demo mode | “Deterministic demo mode with seeded state” | `EcosystemLauncher.jsx` |
| **Execution log export** | `execution-log-export-btn` | Throws “unavailable in this build” if API missing | `ExecutionLogExportCard.jsx` |
| **Policy profile** | Import (no testid on control) | “unavailable for this tier” | `PolicyProfileCard.jsx` |
| **Audit-only** | Thread/workbench save buttons | Disabled with upgrade CTA — real gates, not fake | `ThreadRail.jsx`, `WorkbenchRail.jsx` |
| **MultiWorkspace** | Suggested prompt chips | **No `data-testid`** — functional but harder to target | `MultiWorkspace.jsx` |
| **Stop streaming** | Stop button in pane chat | **No `data-testid`**; calls `llm.cancelStream()` | `MultiWorkspace.jsx` |

**Not theater (despite marketing tone):** Mission Control buttons generally wire to real modal state in `App.jsx`; `bridge.test` and slash-command cards perform real IPC; provider sweep hits live endpoints when allowed.

---

## Testing notes

1. **Default path:** Assert `workspace-panel` + `MultiWorkspace` composer (`composer-send-btn`), not only legacy `WorkspacePanel` chat input.
2. **First boot:** Dismiss `firstboot-*` or `omega-boot-skip-btn` before header tests (`e2e/react-core.spec.js` pattern).
3. **Bridge E2E:** Ollama default; remote providers need keys + **Hosted Provider Access** toggle.
4. **Dynamic IDs:** Parameterize `session-item-*`, `firstboot-step-*`, `pane-model-select-*`, `mission-control-open-*`.
